text:
alex: Heads up — canary run of Mixtral-MoE w/ new fused-attn kernel shows routing p95 jump ~30% (baseline p95=75ms -> 98ms). suspect batching + router hotspots.

maria: saw that in the profiler — flame graph points at router logits + small memcpy bursts. router step moved from ~5ms -> ~18ms on GPU-0 when experts warm up. KV cache fill/evict correlates with spikes.

kevin: config we pushed earlier: {"batcher": {"max_latency_ms": 8, "max_batch_tokens": 2048}, "router": {"top_k": 2, "max_expert_load": 1.2}} — might be too aggressive for the new kernel scheduling.

jamie: quick repro notes: bumping top_k to 3 reduces router stall counts but raises token FLOPs ~+12%. also the RoPE scale tweak (rotary_scale=1.02) we tried slightly regresses perplexity and changes small-matmul timing.

maria: profiler excerpt (p50/p95): fused_attn 3ms/12ms, matmul_kv 2ms/10ms, router_logits 1ms/18ms; memcpy hot windows: 120MB/s transient spikes aligned with first-token-to-expert events.

alex: hypothesis: fused-attn improves bulk token throughput but alters GPU scheduling so the router logits kernel + many small KV memcpys become blocking. MoE per-expert KV caches cause bursty memory traffic when rare experts are pulled into cache (evict+prefetch).

kevin: short-term mitigations: 1) raise batching latency target to 12ms to let router variance amortize, 2) add async prefetch for expert KV (non-blocking memcpy + stream), 3) instrument per-expert token counters and router-logit histograms for alerting.

maria: async prefetch config prototype:
```
"expert_cache": {
  "mode": "async_prefetch",
  "prefetch_ahead": 8,
  "max_cached_tokens": 500000
}
```
also we should add TTL/LRU for extremely low-traffic experts to cap memory.

jamie: additional note re: RoPE & kernel selection — when we nudged rotary_scale the FP range changed enough that the kernel selector preferred a different cuBLAS path for small kv-dim matmuls; that path is measurable slower for our head dims (kv_dim=64). worth locking kernel policy for those shapes.

sre-bot: deploybot: canary rollout started for commit abc123 -> routing.top_k=3, batcher.max_latency_ms=12, rollout=5% traffic.

alex: plan: run 5% canary for 30m, gather metrics: per-expert p99 latency, router-logit histogram, GPU kernel p95, memcpy bytes/sec, expert_cache_evictions/sec, and quality metrics. rollback criteria: p95 > baseline+20% or quality regression flagged.

kevin: i'll add dashboards and an alert rule (expert_cache_evictions/sec > 10 sustained -> page). also adding metric router_topk_collision_rate and per-expert skew.

maria: for expert parallelism: currently expert_shard=2. increasing to 4 lowers per-GPU cache working set but adds cross-GPU router communication. tradeoff test in next canary if this one is noisier.

alex: action items assigned: @jamie investigate RoPE/kernel selector lock, @kevin owns canary dashboards+alerts, @maria wires async prefetch TTL prototype. reconvene after canary or sooner if alerts fire.
